thread:
ben-rls: Quick heads-up — stability window tomorrow 06:00-08:00 PST. Freeze starts T-2 (04:00) and ends T+1h (09:00). Need: rollback owners, canary thresholds, and smoke test runbook. Release notes: https://redwood/releases/2026.3.2 (short)

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: model-service v2026.3.2 -> canary-pool-03. Canary %: 5%. Logs: /deploys/3278904321/canary.log

clara-ops: Ack. I'll own rollback for model-service. If latency p50 > 220ms for 5m OR error-rate > 1% for 3m, we unpin and rollback to v2026.2.9.

ben-rls: @clara-ops thanks — note SLO is 200ms p50 so threshold makes sense as safety cushion. Who's running the smoke checklist at T-10?

alice: I'll run smoke at T-10 and T+15. Quick checklist: health endpoints, /v1/generate sample, KV cache warming, embedding sanity. Will post results here.

sre-miguel: Add these metrics to the canary watch: cpu_gpu_util, token_latency_p50/p95, failed-api-count. I'll wire alerts: pager if error-rate > 1.5% sustained 2m.

diane: Small ask — we have a docs-only patch to release notes. Can we accept an exemptions window for that content change? It's doc-text only; no code.

ben-rls: Docs-only exemption approved. @deploy-bot please allow docs patch without pin bump. Note: any other code change must go through pin/unpin process.

deploy-bot: Canary checkpoint: 10m in. token_latency_p50 = 185ms, p95 = 420ms, error-rate = 0.2%. No anomalies.

frank: Quick reminder on rollback mechanics: unpin -> deploy previous stable image v2026.2.9 -> autoscaler drain 60s -> traffic shift 100% over 2m. If we need faster, call rollback-urgent and we will cutover in 30s (manual).

clara-ops: Noted. If we see sustained p95 > 700ms or error-rate spiking to >3% we escalate to manual rollback-urgent. I'll declare on-call when alarm fires.

alice: Smoke run (T-10): OK, health checks green, sample gen pass, embeddings sanity diff within expected thresholds. Posting snippet: ```curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .status -> "ok"```

deploy-bot: Canary checkpoint: 25m in. token_latency_p50 = 190ms, p95 = 455ms, error-rate = 0.4%. Traffic at 10%. No alerts.

ben-rls: Perfect. Last ops note: keep a 2-person critical path for any unpin (must include release lead + rollback owner). @clara-ops + @ben-rls are the pair. If either is unavailable, escalate to @sre-miguel.

diane: A few release-note bullets to confirm: (1) improved KV cache warmup, (2) tokenization edge-case fix, (3) doc tweaks. Anything else?

frank: Add: minor batching opt that reduces GPU memory under low-QPS. Non-breaking.

ben-rls: Good. Final checklist before freeze: canary metrics within thresholds (OK), smoke passes (OK), rollback owners assigned (OK), docs exemption approved (OK). If no objections in 30m we begin quiet window at 04:00. :thumbsup:

clara-ops: Acknowledged. On-call handoff at 03:50 will include runbook link and playbook snippet. I'll paste runbook here at T-20.

deploy-bot: Canary completed: promoted to ramp stage -> ramping to 30% per policy. Monitor for any regression. Logs: /deploys/3278904321/ramp.log

ben-rls: Thanks team. If anything looks off, shout in #eng-releases and use the rollback-urgent channel for fast action.
